title: Fixes in a bundled proposal
description: The separate changes a BIP bundles (BIP 54's four fixes), each with its rule, the threat it stops, a spec quote at the record's spec revision, where it is already safe, who has to act, and how the rule changed during discussion. Claims point at a fix with the tag fix:<key>. bips/<NNNN>/fixes.yaml.

rule.description: The new rule, in plain words.

quote.description: Verbatim from the spec at spec.revision; the validator checks it.

section.description: Spec section the quote is from.

safe_in.description: Where the rule is already respected, with a verbatim spec quote that says so.

who_acts.description: Who has to do something before activation.

must_act.description: True when someone outside Bitcoin Core has to change software.

story.description: Two sentences on how the rule changed during discussion. Reviewed text.
